سَقْطَةٌ [A fall: or] a violent fall. (M, TA.) ―
-b2- (tropical:) A slip, lapse, fault, or wrong action; as also ↓ سِقَاطٌ ; (S, K;) and ↓ سَقْطٌ ; which last is also used in a pl. sense: (TA:) or the second (سقاط) is pl. of سَقْطَةٌ: (Msb, K:) as sing., it is an inf. n. of سَاقَطَ: (TA:) and سَقْطَةٌ also signifies a bad word or saying, that swerves from rectitude: (TA in art. عور:) its pl., or one of its pls., is سَقَطَاتٌ. (TA.) You say, لَايَخْلُو أَحَدٌ مِنْ سَقْطَةٍ (tropical:) [No one will be free from a slip]. (TA.) And الكَامِلُ مَنْ عُدَّتْ سَقَطَاتُهُ (tropical:) [The perfect is he whose slips are so few that they may be counted]. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
